changes: Released 2026-11-26 (XC_VM-GO, unofficial fork based on XC_VM 2.7.4).

CPU fix on busy load balancers: the ClearKey DASH engine (ckts) checks the sound of every DASH segment by running the system ffmpeg (about 30 times per second on a busy server). The distro ffmpeg loads about 200 libraries on each run (~73 ms of CPU and thousands of memory page faults), which made all cores fight over the kernel memory lock in bursts. That one call now goes to a small static AAC decoder (/opt/qc-ffaac): about 5x less CPU and 7x fewer page faults, same sound result. Everything else still uses the real ffmpeg. No ckts restart.

Go live channels no longer start PHP every minute: XC_VM rewrites its settings cache every minute with the same content, and every Go live channel re-read it through PHP at the same moment. They now re-read it only when the panel settings really change (still applied live).
Updating replaces ffmpeg-golive without restarting odrelay (on-demand viewers stay connected); running live channels use the new version at their next restart.
Includes everything from 2.7.4-p5: ckts memory and core limits sized to the server.
